strings: m_c complains to r_c0 that all the jumbled sounds around {PRONOUN/m_c/object} have left {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} ears aching.
Poor m_c is wincing around camp, extra sensitive due to an earache.
While sounds are already hard for m_c to discern, it's even harder when {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} ears have a sharp pain within.
